title: In Kolkata, the BJP redraws power lines
description: The BJP government in West Bengal has taken up a delimitation exercise of civic bodies of the twin cities of Kolkata and Howrah, increasing the number of wards in both municipal corporations. Opposition parties have claimed there has been gerrymandering. Elections will impact over seven million people. Shrabana Chatterjee and Shiv Sahay Singh examine the delimitation exercise and the related legal challenges
